    <el:luamain><![CDATA[
wo["FollowGrid"] = true
wo["FollowMethod"] = FOLLOW_SCROLL
wo["FollowAction"] = FOLLOW_HALFSCREEN

ti[" "] = {"fl_space"}
ti["-"] = {"fl_metal_2", name="path#"}
ti[","] = {"fl_metal_6", name="path#"}
ti["O"] = {"st_oxyd", flavor="a"}
ti["@"] = {"#ac_marble"}
wo(ti, " ", 150, 100)

function turn_cw(dir)
    return po(-dir.y, dir.x)
end

function turn_ccw(dir)
    return po(dir.y, -dir.x)
end

function draw_part()
    wo[pos] = ti["-"]
    pos = pos + dir
    wo[pos] = ti[","]
    pos = pos + dir
end

function sierpinski(lev)
    if lev == 1 then
        draw_part()
        dir = turn_ccw(dir)
        draw_part()
        dir = turn_cw(dir)
        draw_part()
        dir = turn_cw(dir)
        draw_part()
        draw_part()
        dir = turn_ccw(dir)
        draw_part()
        dir = turn_ccw(dir)
        draw_part()
        dir = turn_cw(dir)
        draw_part()
    else
        sierpinski(lev-1)
        dir = turn_ccw(dir)
        sierpinski(lev-1)
        dir = turn_cw(dir)
        sierpinski(lev-1)
        dir = turn_cw(dir)
        sierpinski(lev-1)
        sierpinski(lev-1)
        dir = turn_ccw(dir)
        sierpinski(lev-1)
        dir = turn_ccw(dir)
        sierpinski(lev-1)
        dir = turn_cw(dir)
        sierpinski(lev-1)
    end
end

wo[no["path#*"]:shuffle()[1]] = ti["@"]
 ]]></el:luamain>
